enumerate_surfaces_for_saving: enumerate all symmetrically distinct surfaces of a bulk crystal structure up to a given Miller index
standardize_bulk: standardize a bulk unit cell to its conventional standard structure using space group analysis
is_structure_invertible: check if a crystal structure is symmetric with respect to the x-y plane
flip_struct: flip a crystal structure upside down by rotating 180 degrees around the x-axis
run_precompute_enumerate_surface: run the CLI script to precompute and pickle enumerated surface structures for a given bulk index
